name: ak:html-video
syntax: /ak:html-video [video brief, source URL, repo, template id, or project id]
overview: Create local MP4 videos from HTML/CSS/JS templates with nexu-io/html-video. Covers source checkout setup, template discovery, studio customization, preview, and render verification.
whenToUse: Invoke for HTML-first video generation, template-driven promos, explainers, data videos, or social clips that should render locally through Chromium and ffmpeg.

invocation.claude-code: /ak:html-video [video brief, source URL, repo, template id, or project id]
invocation.codex: $ak:html-video [video brief, source URL, repo, template id, or project id]

subcommands.name: html-video CLI not found
subcommands.desc: Install a global binary if available, or set HTML_VIDEO_HOME to a built source checkout.
